# Hybrid Policy Launch 2026-04-01

First day of fixed anchor days (Tuesday to Thursday) under [[hybrid-work-policy-v1]]. A Wednesday, so the first anchor day was also day one.

## What happened

- Head Office desk bookings hit 104% of the 520 desks by 08:40; overflow bookings into meeting rooms were only switched on by Facilities on 2026-04-07 ([[head-office-desk-occupancy-2026]]).
- 74 hybrid tickets on 1 and 2 April alone, against about 2 a day in March. Top themes: no desk free, part-time staff asking which days count, compressed-hours staff whose day off is a Wednesday or Thursday.
- The FAQ had no answer for part-time or compressed hours. Leon and I answered from a holding line agreed with [[priyanka-desai]] that afternoon ("talk to your manager; HR will confirm by 14 April").

## Follow-up

- Four FAQ answers added on 2026-04-14 ([[hybrid-policy-faq]]).
- Ticket review with the team on 2026-04-28 ([[helpdesk-hybrid-ticket-review-2026-04-28]]).
